topics.title: The 9 Ball Flights
topics.subtitle: Every shot fits one of nine patterns
topics.defaultPrompt: Walk me through the nine ball flights — every combination of starting direction and curve. What does each one tell me about my path and face, and which ones reveal which faults?
topics.promptTemplate: Walk me through the nine ball flight patterns — starting direction (left/straight/right) crossed with curve (left/straight/right). What does each pattern tell me about path and face? {{skill_level_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: I'm new to ball flight — keep it simple and visual.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I understand the basic concept — help me see all nine patterns clearly.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include the face-vs-path numbers that produce each, and the typical mechanical causes of each pattern.

options.label: Quick Reference
options.promptFragment: Give me a clean table or list of the nine patterns.

options.label: Detailed Explanation
options.promptFragment: Walk through each pattern with the underlying mechanics.

options.label: Use as Diagnostic
options.promptFragment: Frame this as a diagnostic — for each pattern, what is my swing telling me.

topics.title: Path vs Face — The New Laws
topics.subtitle: Why old-school ball flight teaching was wrong
topics.defaultPrompt: Explain the new ball flight laws (post-2007 launch monitor era). Specifically, the ball starts mostly toward where the face points, not where the path goes. Walk me through what changed and why old teaching was wrong.
topics.promptTemplate: Explain the new ball flight laws — that starting direction is dominated by clubface (about 80%), not swing path. Cover what changed when launch monitors revealed it, and how teaching shifted. {{skill_level_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: Keep the explanation simple — what does this mean for me.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I've heard about the new laws — go deeper on why it matters.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include the 85/15 rule, gear effect on the driver, and how ball compression and friction angle interact.

options.label: Quick Answer
options.promptFragment: Give me the headline and what to do with it.

options.label: Detailed Explanation
options.promptFragment: Walk through old teaching, what TrackMan revealed, and the corrected laws.

options.label: What This Changes
options.promptFragment: Focus on what these laws change about how I should think about my swing.

topics.title: Attack Angle
topics.subtitle: Hitting up or down — when each is right

topics.promptTemplate: Explain attack angle — what it is, when to hit down vs up, optimal AoA by club, and how attack angle affects distance, spin, and trajectory. {{skill_level_context}} {{club_context}} {{detail_level_context}}
